summary.title: Intel® Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Programming Reference
summary.one_liner: Intel's reference for instruction set extensions that may appear in future Intel processors, with no availability guarantee.
takeaways: The document describes software programming interfaces for Intel instruction extensions that may appear in future Intel processor generations.
Intel explicitly does not guarantee availability of these interfaces and features in any future product.
The page is a versioned document (listed version 62 as latest, dated 2022-12-29) with earlier versions 47 to 61 available.
summary.summary: This Intel developer page hosts the Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Programming Reference, a document describing software interfaces for instruction extensions and features that may be included in future Intel processor generations. The page text states that Intel does not guarantee these interfaces will appear in any future product. The page shows a download link, a date of 2022-12-29, and a version list with version 62 marked as latest. The text provided does not include the instruction details themselves, so specific extensions are not confirmed from this page alone.
